QUOTE: `$ENTROPIC_LIB`, then `$ENTROPIC_HOME` (nested and flat layouts), then `~/.entropic/`, then the system `ldconfig` cache
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gives the order of env overrides, then the user directory, then the system cache. But it ties "nested and flat layouts" only to `$ENTROPIC_HOME`, not to two layouts tried per root.
